non_claims: Not a global, exhaustive, or representative water/ice survey for any body.
No ice fraction, subsurface ice volume, mineable ice, or liquid-water inventory is claimed.

Hydrogen/neutron/CPR values are evidence or proxies, not confirmed ice unless a source-specific detection criterion is explicitly met and recorded; none are confirmed ice detections in current indexed observations.
not_detected and no_coverage are distinct states; no-detection is never converted to no-ice.
Hydrated-mineral spectral evidence is D02 evidence and is not duplicated as D04 similarity/filter evidence.
No D04 similarity/filter score is produced from these observations; cross-body equivalence is not claimed.
